correctness.rationale: PASS. For every fixed 0<q<1 and balance d=(1-q)/2, two mirrored branch families of widths w_j=dq^j cover the interval modulo endpoints, each maps bijectively onto (0,1) with inverse slope w_j. This proves Lebesgue invariance and independent symbolic cylinders of measure product_j w_j; shrinking cylinders identify a Bernoulli shift, giving finite entropy and Lyapunov exponent -log d-[q/(1-q)]log q. Graph closure is the countable union of unit-height slanted segments plus central vertical accumulation segment, hence infinite H^1 and Hausdorff dimension one. For N_+(eps)≈log(1/eps)/log(1/q), first N pairs have Euclidean epsilon-neighborhood area at most 4eps N+O_q(eps), while remaining tails lie in an O(eps) central strip. For N_-(eps) chosen by w_{N-1}>4eps and q^N>4eps, 2N horizontal epsilon-intervals at each y are pairwise disjoint and yield >=4eps N. Together give the exact leading coefficient 4/log(1/q), O_q(eps) remainder and upper/lower box dimension one. Endpoint extensions do not alter closed open-branch graph or a.e. coding.
